So 5 Earth masses same composition will have density > 5.5 g/cm^3.
d) Same composition as Earth but half the mass. Lower mass, less compression, so density is less than Earth's density (<5.5).

a: ~5.5
b: ~5.5
c: >5.5
d: <5.5
